name: API Browser help
description: Help mode entries of the API Browser (help@1): its page, settings and every control it draws.
author: Brett

entries.title: API Browser
entries.text: Every way to drive the console without touching it: control@1, plugin commands, MCP tools, REST routes and the CLI, each with its policy, its names and a Try it.

entries.title: API Browser settings
entries.text: Which view the API Browser opens on, the look of its view switcher, and whether Try it may run changes.

entries.title: Look of the view switcher
entries.text: Top tabs, a side rail or chips: one of the three tab-group looks the API Browser ships. Right-click the switcher for its own settings too.

entries.title: Try it may run changes
entries.text: Off: Try it runs reads only. On: a change asks you once before it runs, and a delete asks for its confirm token as well.

entries.title: Make it again
entries.text: Reads the code again (control@1, every plugin, the MCP server, the CLI) and rebuilds the list now, instead of waiting for the next change.

entries.title: Policy
entries.text: Show only the paths that run at once (reads), wait out the 90 s veto (changes), need a confirm token (deletes) or need Brett's own tap.

entries.title: Close the detail
entries.text: Hides the detail pane and gives the list the whole width.

entries.title: Copy the REST path
entries.text: Copies the method and path, ready for curl or another app.

entries.title: Copy the CLI command
entries.text: Copies the axf command that does the same from a terminal.

entries.title: Run with the confirm token
entries.text: The first run of a delete only answered with a confirm token; this runs it for real with that token. Tell Brett first.
